To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Chinese family visitors’ interactive experiences in museums have positive impacts on their BI with the perceived benefits (mindfulness benefits and non-mindership benefits) as the mediate variables.

(a) the perceived benefits are the key mediating variable in the relationship between visitors’ interactive experiences and their behavioural intentions; (b) the mindful benefits are the most significant variable in the mediating effect, and the non-mindful benefit is the least significant; and (c) the experience of existential authenticity has a stronger influence than the experience of parents- children interaction on the visitors’ interactive experiences.
the experience of existential authenticity is more powerful than the experience of parents- children interaction in shaping family visitors’ behavioural intentions in museums.
